metadata.gitb:name: Spenser dispenses N dark chocolates and inventory drops by N
metadata.gitb:description: The tester enters a number N. The test reads the current dark-chocolate count (X), POSTs N orders for "chocolate-dark" with a 2-second delay between each, then re-reads the inventory and asserts the count is X - N. Reference profile: http://costateixeira.github.io/spenser Default endpoint: http://spenser.local
